props.name: actionsRef
props.description: A ref to imperative actions. - `unmount`: Ends the closing phase of the autocomplete after an externally controlled closing animation finishes. Call `preventUnmountOnClose()` in `onOpenChange` first, otherwise the autocomplete completes closing on its own. Whether it leaves the DOM is decided by `keepMounted` on the portal. - `close`: Closes the autocomplete imperatively when called.

props.name: autoHighlight
props.description: Whether the first matching item is highlighted automatically. - `true`: highlight after the user types and keep the highlight while the query changes. - `'always'`: always highlight the first item.

props.name: children
props.description: The popup's content, rendered inside `Autocomplete.Content`. Pass an `Autocomplete.List` that renders each item as an `Autocomplete.Item`, and an `Autocomplete.Empty` beside it for the list that matches nothing. The Empty needs `items`, since it shows only while the filtered items are empty. For groups, render each group through `Autocomplete.Collection` inside the List, as an `Autocomplete.Group` that takes the group's `items`, with an `Autocomplete.Label` and a second `Autocomplete.Collection` for its rows. An `Autocomplete.Separator` draws the rule between groups.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the field's root.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popup is initially open. To render a controlled popup, use the `open` prop instead.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The uncontrolled input value of the autocomplete when it's initially rendered. To render a controlled autocomplete, use the `value` prop instead.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting text, rendered as `Field.Description` below the error.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: The error message, rendered as `Field.Error` under the input, ahead of the description, while it is truthy. Pass `isInvalid` with it, so the input is marked invalid too. Without it, the field shows its own error, such as one `Form` holds under its `name` or the required message.

props.name: filter
props.type: ((item: ItemValue, query: string, itemToString?: ((item: ItemValue) => string) | undefined) => boolean) | null | undefined
props.description: The function that matches items against the text. For a search that runs elsewhere, such as a register lookup on a server, pass `filter={null}` and the results as `items`, and the list shows them as given. Keep the request and its state in your component, pass the empty list's states as `Autocomplete.Empty`'s children and the rest as `status`.

props.name: filteredItems
props.description: The items the list shows, for filtering outside the list, such as with Base UI's `useFilter()` hook. When given, the list shows these and does not filter `items` itself. With `items` also given, this array keeps its own flat or grouped structure. Nullish entries are not supported, as in `items`.

props.name: form
props.description: Identifies the form that owns the internal input. Useful when the autocomplete is rendered outside the form.

props.name: grid
props.description: Whether list items are presented in a grid layout. When enabled, arrow keys navigate across rows and columns inferred from DOM rows.

props.name: highlightItemOnHover
props.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them. Disabling this prop allows CSS `:hover` to be differentiated from the `:focus` (`data-highlighted`) state.

props.name: id
props.description: The id of the component.

props.name: inputClassName
props.description: Extra classes for the input's field box, which fills the field's width.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: A ref to the hidden input element.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field, the input and its buttons.

props.name: isInvalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid, with the invalid look.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Makes the input read-only, with the muted read-only fill. The input stays focusable and its popup still opens to show the suggestions, but picking one, typing and the clear button change nothing. The text still submits under `name`.

props.name: isRequired
props.description: Makes the input required, so an empty submit is blocked with the required message.

props.name: itemToStringValue
props.description: Returns the text an object item fills the input with and submits. With groups, it receives one item of a group, not the group. A `{ value, label }` item uses its `label` without it.

props.name: items
props.description: The items to suggest: a flat array, or an array of groups that each carry a `value` and their own `items`. Nullish entries are not supported. Base UI filters them against the text in the locale of `LocaleProvider`. A group whose items all fail to match hides with them.

props.name: keepHighlight
props.description: Whether the highlighted item should be preserved when the pointer leaves the list.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, rendered as `Field.Label` 4px above the input. It names the input. For a label row with an info button, or a horizontal field, compose `Field.Root` and the `Autocomplete` parts instead.

props.name: limit
props.description: The maximum number of items to display in the list.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether to loop keyboard focus back to the input when the end of the list is reached while using the arrow keys. The first item can then be reached by pressing <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd> again from the input, or the last item can be reached by pressing <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd> from the input. The input is always included in the focus loop per [ARIA Authoring Practices](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/combobox/). When disabled, focus does not move when on the last element and the user presses <kbd>ArrowDown</kbd>, or when on the first element and the user presses <kbd>ArrowUp</kbd>.

props.name: modal
props.description: Determines if the popup enters a modal state when open. - `true`: user interaction is limited to the popup: document page scroll is locked and pointer interactions on outside elements are disabled. - `false`: user interaction with the rest of the document is allowed. On touch devices, a `true` modal blocks outside taps but leaves the page scrollable unless the popup spans nearly the full viewport width, matching native iOS behavior.

props.name: mode
props.description: Controls how the autocomplete behaves with respect to list filtering and inline autocompletion. - `list` (default): items are dynamically filtered based on the input value. The input value does not change based on the active item. - `both`: items are dynamically filtered based on the input value, which will temporarily change based on the active item (inline autocompletion). - `inline`: items are static (not filtered), and the input value will temporarily change based on the active item (inline autocompletion). - `none`: items are static (not filtered), and the input value will not change based on the active item.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` the text submits under, and under which `Form` routes its errors. A `Form` error under it shows below the input, also in the first HTML a server renders, until the user edits the text.

props.name: onItemHighlighted
props.type: ((highlightedValue: ItemValue | undefined, eventDetails: HighlightEventDetails) => void) | undefined
props.description: Callback fired when an item is highlighted or unhighlighted. Receives the highlighted item value (or `undefined` if no item is highlighted) and event details with a `reason` property describing why the highlight changed. The `reason` can be: - `'keyboard'`: the highlight changed due to keyboard navigation. - `'pointer'`: the highlight changed due to pointer hovering. The event may be a `MouseEvent` rather than a `PointerEvent`. - `'none'`: the highlight changed for another reason, such as typing, `autoHighlight`, the item list changing, or the popup opening or closing.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Event handler called when the popup is opened or closed.

props.name: onOpenChangeComplete
props.description: Event handler called after any animations complete when the popup is opened or closed.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the input's text on every change. It receives only the string, so capture a picked item in `Autocomplete.Item`'s `onClick`, which runs on a click and on Enter while the item is highlighted.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is currently open. Use when controlled.

props.name: openOnInputClick
props.description: Whether the popup opens when clicking the input.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The text the empty input shows.

props.name: ref
props.description: The input the user types in. `inputRef` is the Root's hidden input. The props the field does not name, `id` included, go to `Autocomplete.Root`, and the label points at that `id`.

props.name: showClear
props.description: Renders a button that empties the input while it holds text. Its name is the locale dictionary's `clear` string.

props.name: showTrigger
props.description: Renders the caret button, which opens the whole list for browsing. The list opens as the user types, so the field has no caret unless you pass this. The caret hides while the clear button shows. Its name is the locale dictionary's `toggle` string.

props.name: status
props.description: The state of a search the app runs, such as the number of results, rendered in `Autocomplete.Status` beside the input. It stays mounted while the popup opens and closes, so screen readers announce each change. Pass the empty list's states, such as loading or no results, as `Autocomplete.Empty`'s children instead.

props.name: submitOnItemClick
props.description: Whether clicking an item should submit the autocomplete's owning form. By default, clicking an item via a pointer or <kbd>Enter</kbd> key does not submit the owning form. Useful when the autocomplete is used as a single-field form search input.

props.name: value
props.description: The text in the input, for a controlled field, whether the user typed it or picked a suggestion. Text that matches no suggestion stays on blur and submits as it is.

props.name: virtualized
props.description: Whether the items are being externally virtualized.
